1.stem_plain: Mother told my cousins and me to share the pizza among __________.

2.stem_plain: Last evening, Jim __________ annoyed when the doorbell kept ringing.

3.stem_plain: "I need a packet of flour now! I __________ a cake for the party later," exclaimed Mother.

4.stem_plain: __________ pupils standing there are in the school basketball team.

5.stem_plain: While we __________ our dinner at our favourite restaurant, the fire alarm went off.

6.stem_plain: Josie and her brother __________ sad when their pet rabbit escaped from its cage.

7.stem_plain: Li Chang __________ some books from the library on her way home yesterday.

8.stem_plain: We have __________ bananas but not many oranges in the kitchen.

9.stem_plain: I __________ only a cup of orange juice at breakfast just now.

10.stem_plain: Grandmother cooked us so __________ food that the dishes looked untouched at the end of dinner.

1.zh: 母亲让我们堂表亲和我自己把比萨分了。
1.note: 动作的承受者包含说话者本人和堂表亲（my cousins and me，即“我们”），对应的反身代词应该是 ourselves（我们自己）。
1.concept: 反身代词 — Reflexive Pronouns — ourselves

2.zh: 昨天傍晚，当门铃响个不停时，吉姆感到很恼火。
2.note: “Last evening”（昨天傍晚）提示过去时间，主语 “Jim” 是单数，因此选用单数过去式系动词 was。
2.concept: 系动词过去时与主谓一致 — Simple Past Tense of 'be'

3.zh: “我现在需要一包面粉！我正在为待会儿的聚会烤蛋糕呢，”母亲大声说道。
3.note: 前半句的 “now!”（现在）表明烤蛋糕是一项此刻正在着手或正在进行中的动作，因此动词使用现在进行时 am baking。
3.concept: 现在进行时 — Present Continuous Tense

4.zh: 站在那边的那些学生是学校篮球队的。
4.note: “pupils” 为复数名词，且 “standing there”（站在那边）提示距离较远，因此选用远称复数的指示代词 Those。
4.concept: 指示代词 — Demonstrative Pronouns — Those

5.zh: 当我们在我们最喜欢的餐厅吃晚饭时，火警警报器响了。
5.note: “While” 引导的时间状语从句表示过去一个正在持续进行的动作，主语为 we，因此使用过去进行时复数形式 were eating。
5.concept: 过去进行时 — Past Continuous Tense

6.zh: 当他们的宠物兔从笼子里逃走时，乔西和她的哥哥很难过。
6.note: 从句中的 “escaped” 提示过去时间，主语 “Josie and her brother” 是两个人（复数），因此选用复数过去式系动词 were。
6.concept: 主谓一致与一般过去时 — Subject-Verb Agreement & Simple Past Tense

7.zh: 李昶昨天在回家的路上从图书馆借了几本书。
7.note: 时间状语 “yesterday”（昨天）明确提示过去时间，谓语动词应选用一般过去式 borrowed。
7.concept: 一般过去时 — Simple Past Tense

8.zh: 我们在厨房里有几根香蕉，但是橙子不多。
8.note: “bananas” 是可数名词复数，后半句的 “but not many oranges”（但橙子不多）在语意上形成了少量的对比，故选用修饰可数名词的 a few（几根）。
8.concept: 修饰可数名词的量词 — Quantifiers with Countable Nouns — a few

9.zh: 我刚才早餐时只喝了一杯橙汁。
9.note: “just now”（刚才）表示过去的时间点，因此谓语动词应选用一般过去式 drank。
9.concept: 一般过去时 — Simple Past Tense

10.zh: 奶奶给我们做了这么多食物，以至于晚饭结束时那些菜看起来就像没动过一样。
10.note: “food”（食物）是不可数名词，且后半句提到晚饭结束菜几乎没少（looked untouched），说明做的分量极其多，因此用 “so much” 来修饰。
10.concept: 修饰不可数名词的量词 — Quantifiers with Uncountable Nouns — so much

11.stem_plain: At the supermarket, Mother bought a basket full of __________ to prepare meals for the next two weeks.

12.stem_plain: Mark damaged his classmate's water bottle and would have to take __________ for his action.

13.stem_plain: The brave firemen fought hard to __________ the flames of the forest fire.

14.stem_plain: The chef has used __________ spices to cook the rice. It smells delicious.

15.stem_plain: The customer was __________ with the clumsy waitress when she tripped and spilled soup on him.

11.zh: 在超市里，母亲买了一篮子食品杂货，准备接下来两周的饭菜。
11.note: “groceries” 意为“食品杂货”，在超市（supermarket）里购买并用来做饭（prepare meals）最契合此语境。
11.concept: 名词词义辨析 — Vocabulary (Nouns) — groceries

choices.eg: The mechanic carried a heavy box of tools to fix the broken car engine.
The waiter placed the polished silver cutlery neatly on the dinner table.
We need to wash all the cooking utensils after preparing the big feast.
She packed the fresh vegetables and milk into bags after paying for the groceries.

12.zh: 马克弄坏了同学的水杯，必须为自己的行为承担责任。
12.note: “take responsibility for” 是固定搭配，意为“对……承担责任”，符合做错事后需要负责的语境。
12.concept: 词汇固定搭配与语境理解 — Collocations — take responsibility

choices.zh: 控制，支配（take control of为控制……）
choices.eg: The experienced pilot managed to take control of the aircraft during the storm.

choices.zh: 主动性，倡议（take the initiative为采取主动）
choices.eg: You should take the initiative to introduce yourself to the new neighbors.
The committee has the full authority to make final decisions on the budget.
As the team captain, he decided to take responsibility for the sudden defeat.

13.zh: 勇敢的消防员们奋力扑灭森林大火的烈焰。
13.note: “extinguish the flames” 是固定搭配，意为“扑灭烈焰”。虽然 quench 也有熄灭之意，但一般多与 thirst（解渴）搭配，扑灭大火的火焰最标准和常用的动词是 extinguish。
13.concept: 动词固定搭配与近义词辨析 — Collocations — extinguish the flames

choices.eg: The loud loud music in the hall managed to drown out their conversation.

choices.zh: 解（渴），熄灭（常指火星或口渴）
choices.eg: Drinking a glass of ice-cold lemonade is the best way to quench your thirst.
The thick smoke from the burning building can quickly suffocate trapped people.
The automated sprinkler system triggered quickly to extinguish the room fire.

14.zh: 大厨使用了芳香的香料来煮饭。闻起来香极了。
14.note: 后文提到 “It smells delicious”（闻起来美味），说明所用的香料气味非常好，因此选用 “aromatic”（芳香的）。
14.concept: 形容词词义辨析与语境线索 — Vocabulary (Adjectives) — aromatic

choices.zh: 诱人的（多修饰食物整体外观，不直接修饰spices的气味）
choices.eg: The chocolate cake displayed in the bakery window looked highly tempting.
She enjoyed waking up to the rich and aromatic smell of fresh coffee beans.
The garden was filled with colorful flowers that attracted many butterflies.

choices.zh: 洒了香水的，有浓郁香气的（常指人工香水、化妆品或花朵香，不用于日常烹饪香料）
choices.eg: She received a beautiful bouquet of heavily perfumed lilies on her anniversary.

15.zh: 当那个笨手笨脚的女服务员绊倒并将汤泼在他身上时，这位顾客非常生气。
15.note: “cross” 在这里作形容词，意为“生气的、愤怒的”，符合衣服被泼了汤时的正常情绪反应。
15.concept: 多义词/形容词词义辨析 — Vocabulary (Adjectives) — cross

choices.eg: Please don't get cross with me; I really did not mean to break your favorite mug.
The teacher was pleased with the excellent results of the entire class.
The restaurant customers were fully satisfied with the exceptional service.

choices.zh: 失望的（语气较轻，被泼汤更倾向于感到愤怒 cross）
choices.eg: He felt extremely disappointed when the concert was suddenly canceled due to rain.

21.stem_plain: According to the visual text, the main purpose is to ________.

21.note: 解释为什么选这个答案 — replace stems, passages, and teaching copy when content is ready.
指代上文提到的“一个闪闪发光的盒子（a shiny box）”。盒子是单数无生命物体，在句中作showed的宾语，故使用人称代词宾格“it”（它）。

22.note: 指代“我和我的朋友杰克（I and Jake）”。后面紧跟动词found作主语，表示复数的“我们”，故使用人称代词主格“we”（我们）。

23.note: 指代他们找到的“一些旧硬币（some old coins）”。硬币是复数概念，在句中作placed的宾语，故使用人称代词宾格“them”（它们）。

24.note: 指代凑近看的“杰克（Jake）”。杰克是男性，在句中作exclaimed的主语，故使用男性人称代词主格“he”（他）。

cloze: I was playing in the park when I saw a shiny box under a tree. I showed [Q21] to my friend, Jake. "Look at this!" I said. Jake helped me open the box and together, [Q22] found some old coins. We placed [Q23] in our hands.
Jake took a closer look. Delighted, [Q24] exclaimed, "This is fascinating!" I nodded in agreement. We decided to keep the matter a secret for now.
zh: 我正在公园里玩，这时我看到树下有一个闪闪发光的盒子。我把它展示给我的朋友杰克看。“看这个！”我说。杰克帮我打开了盒子，我们在一起找到了一些旧硬币。我们把它们放在手里。
杰克凑近看了看。他很高兴地惊呼道：“这太迷人了！”我点头表示赞同。我们决定暂时对这件事保密。

29.stem_plain: The fried chicken looks delicious. Mary has no appetite to eat the fried chicken now.

30.stem_plain: My mother loves to bake. Sharon loves to bake too.

31.stem_plain: I was at the toilet. The thief took my belongings.

32.stem_plain: The woman is upset. The woman's dress is dirtied by the waiter.

29.zh: 虽然炸鸡看起来很美味，但玛丽现在没有胃口吃它。
29.note: ‘Although’ 引导让步状语从句，句首大写。后面连接第一个分句，逗号后连接主句。注意主句中的代词替换，避免重复出现 ‘the fried chicken’。
29.answer: Although the fried chicken looks delicious, Mary has no appetite to eat it now.

30.zh: 我母亲和莎伦都喜欢烘焙。
30.note: ‘Both ... and ...’ 连接两个单数主语时，谓语动词要用复数形式（loves 变为 love）。
30.answer: Both my mother and Sharon love to bake.

31.zh: 当我在洗手间时，小偷偷走了我的财物。
31.note: ‘while’ 引导时间状语从句，表示在一个持续性动作发生期间，另一个动作发生了。从句通常紧跟在 ‘while’ 后面。
31.answer: The thief took my belongings while I was at the toilet.

32.zh: 那个衣服被服务员弄脏的女人很不高兴。
32.note: 使用关系代词 ‘whose’ 引导定语从句，替代所有格 ‘The woman's’，紧跟在先行词 ‘The woman’ 后面作为插入语，后面接主句的剩余部分。
32.answer: The woman whose dress is dirtied by the waiter is upset.

paragraphs.1: 第一段从第1行开始，第一段的翻译。
